procedure: two blind agent reviewers (fresh contexts, different model families) + adjudicator/final approver (project owner); not a human double review
reviewer_models: Reviewers A and B; exact identifiers are in a private run specification (not in this repository), linked only by hash below.

tool_call_audit.method: reviewer transcripts scanned for every tool call

reviewer_B.writes: reviewerB/part1-4 (Write x4, Edit x1) and one read-only validation script

reviewer_process_limits: Reviewer A recorded decisions as index sets in one script and the script filled non_personal/P4 for every item not listed (197 items, default_filled, review_unverified). Its evidence field is a mechanical excerpt around the span, not a rationale.
Reviewer B wrote per-item evidence; evidence strings are verbatim sentence substrings for both (validated).
Agreement between the two reviewers is not evidence of correctness.
private_run_spec_contents: requested model identifiers, response-reported model identifiers, run start/end times, transcript hashes
